panels.title: Public Readiness
panels.description: PostgreSQL-aware /readyz state with deployment identity validation.

panels.title: Terminal Request Rate
panels.description: Requests counted only at Caddy's terminal subroute handler, avoiding per-handler double counting.

panels.title: 4xx Ratio
panels.description: Client-error ratio; absent when there were no requests, because zero traffic is not 0% errors.

panels.title: 429 Ratio
panels.description: Rate-limit response ratio at the terminal subroute.

panels.title: 5xx Ratio
panels.description: Server-error ratio at the terminal subroute.

panels.title: Upstream And Middleware Error Rate
panels.description: Errors reported inside Caddy's terminal subroute; inspect alongside the terminal 5xx ratio because middleware or upstream failures can be recovered before the final response. A source-backed zero is derived only while Caddy is up and its terminal request counter is present.

panels.title: Upstream Health
panels.description: Caddy active-health state when a safe reverse_proxy health_uri is configured. The current backend has no active health check, so global absence is rendered as an explicit disabled state; use Caddy Active for scrape/process health.
panels.noValue: Unavailable — Caddy upstream-health configuration state cannot be determined

-1.text: Disabled by configuration — no active health_uri

panels.title: API Error Ratio
panels.description: Errors divided by all requests; absent when no requests occurred.

panels.title: Last Successfully Verified Backup Age
panels.description: Age of the newest successfully verified backend backup against the standardized 30-hour freshness objective.
panels.noValue: Unavailable — successfully verified backend backup telemetry is missing

dashboards.title: NutsNews Backend PostgreSQL Failover
dashboards.missingRemoteObjectReason: Grafana Cloud Apply run 29984664724 reported this dashboard UID does not exist remotely, so OpenTofu creates it from the source catalog instead of importing it.

panels.title: Sync Relay Configuration State
panels.description: Explicit one-hot pass, fail, not_configured, or unknown state; not_configured is a deliberate disabled state rather than No data.

panels.title: Sync Relay Expected Active
panels.description: Protected deployment-mode signal. Zero means the unsafe snapshot relay is deliberately suspended; one means all relay health, lag, and table checks are required.

dashboards.title: NutsNews Backend PostgreSQL Operations
dashboards.description: PostgreSQL exporter coverage for availability, connections, transactions, locks, cache, checkpoints, vacuum, storage, WAL, and replication.
dashboards.missingRemoteObjectReason: New source-controlled PostgreSQL operations dashboard for the Grafana Cloud observability enhancement.

panels.title: Transactions
panels.description: Combined commit and rollback transaction rate by database.

panels.title: Cache Hit Ratio
panels.description: Block hits divided by hits plus reads; absent when the database reported no block activity.
panels.expr: (sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job="nutsnews-backend-postgres"}[5m])) / (sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job="nutsnews-backend-postgres"}[5m])) + sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{job="nutsnews-backend-postgres"}[5m])))) and on(datname) ((sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job="nutsnews-backend-postgres"}[5m])) + sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read{job="nutsnews-backend-postgres"}[5m]))) > 0)

panels.title: Checkpoints And Buffers
panels.description: Version-compatible scheduled-checkpoint rate plus the independently emitted buffer-allocation rate from postgres_exporter counter families.

panels.title: Autovacuum Activity
panels.description: Active autovacuum start timestamps and the emitted total, scanned, and vacuumed heap-block gauges. The -1 sentinel means PostgreSQL is queryable but no vacuum is active; exporter or database loss remains unavailable.
panels.noValue: Unavailable — PostgreSQL exporter or database telemetry is missing

-1.text: Idle — no autovacuum or manual vacuum is active

panels.expr: (pg_stat_activity_autovacuum_timestamp_seconds{job="nutsnews-backend-postgres"} or pg_stat_progress_vacuum_heap_blks{job="nutsnews-backend-postgres"} or pg_stat_progress_vacuum_heap_blks_scanned{job="nutsnews-backend-postgres"} or pg_stat_progress_vacuum_heap_blks_vacuumed{job="nutsnews-backend-postgres"}) or on() label_replace(((0 * (max(pg_up{job="nutsnews-backend-postgres"}) == 1)) - 1), "activity", "idle", "", "")

panels.title: WAL Growth
panels.description: Positive fifteen-minute slope of the current pg_wal directory size gauge; segment recycling decreases are clamped to zero.

panels.title: Replication State And Lag
panels.description: Server replication lag in seconds plus emitted physical/logical slot activity and retained-WAL byte families. A host-owned -1 sentinel explicitly identifies a standalone primary with replication monitoring disabled; configured-but-missing exporter families remain unavailable.
panels.noValue: Unavailable — configured replication collector telemetry is missing

-1.text: Disabled by configuration — standalone primary has no replication target

panels.expr: ((pg_replication_lag_seconds{job="nutsnews-backend-postgres"} or pg_replication_slots_active{job="nutsnews-backend-postgres"} or pg_replication_slots_slot_is_active{job="nutsnews-backend-postgres"} or pg_replication_slots_pg_wal_lsn_diff{job="nutsnews-backend-postgres"}) and on() (max(nutsnews_backend_postgres_replication_lag_configured{job="nutsnews-backend-host"}) == 1)) or on() label_replace(((0 * (max(nutsnews_backend_postgres_replication_lag_configured{job="nutsnews-backend-host"}) == 0)) - 1), "replication_state", "disabled_by_configuration", "", "")

panels.title: SSH Auth Failure Volume
panels.expr: sum(count_over_time({host="backend.nutsnews.com",service="security",source="auth"} |~ "(?i)(failed password|invalid user|authentication failure|maximum authentication attempts)" [15m])) or vector(0)

dashboards.title: NutsNews Worker Pipeline Run Drilldown
dashboards.description: Cross-service worker event rate, structured identifier fields, and log timeline filtered by one exact pipeline, correlation, or W3C trace-context value. No Tempo or indexed identifier labels are used.
dashboards.missingRemoteObjectReason: New source-controlled Loki correlation dashboard for the Grafana Cloud observability enhancement.

panels.title: Matched Events By Service And Outcome
panels.description: Event volume for one exact high-cardinality identifier, parsed only at query time and reduced to bounded service/outcome dimensions.
panels.noValue: Enter an identifier value or no matching events exist in the selected time range
panels.expr: sum by (service, outcome) (count_over_time({deployment_environment=~"$environment",host=~"$host",source="container",service=~"$service"} | json | pipelineRunId=~"^${identifier_value:regex}$" or pipeline_run_id=~"^${identifier_value:regex}$" or correlationId=~"^${identifier_value:regex}$" or correlation_id=~"^${identifier_value:regex}$" or traceparent=~"^${identifier_value:regex}$" | keep service, outcome [$__interval]))

panels.title: Structured Identifier Fields
panels.description: Query-time JSON fields with per-value links back to this bounded drilldown. Camel-case runtime fields and snake-case service aliases are both supported.
panels.noValue: Enter an identifier value or no matching identifier fields exist in the selected time range
panels.expr: {deployment_environment=~"$environment",host=~"$host",source="container",service=~"$service"} | json | pipelineRunId=~"^${identifier_value:regex}$" or pipeline_run_id=~"^${identifier_value:regex}$" or correlationId=~"^${identifier_value:regex}$" or correlation_id=~"^${identifier_value:regex}$" or traceparent=~"^${identifier_value:regex}$" | keep service, severity, outcome, pipelineRunId, pipeline_run_id, correlationId, correlation_id, traceparent

panels.title: Cross-Service Pipeline Log Timeline
panels.description: Raw structured worker logs matching the selected pipeline-run, correlation, or W3C trace-context identifier; no Tempo lookup is performed.
panels.noValue: Enter an identifier value or no matching events exist in the selected time range
